description: Single storey front and side extension; first floor side-extension, alterations  and extension to roof; rear dormer; rooflights in front and side roof slopes; re-Location of main entrance; front entrance canopy; external alterations (demolition of car port and attached garage)
decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The ground and first floor windows in the side flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><ul><li>2019/98 - 01A; </li><li>2019/98 - 02A; </li><li>2019/98 - 03A; </li><li>2019/98 - 04A;&nbsp;</li><li>2019/98 - 05A;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li><li>2019/98 - 06A; </li><li>2019/98 - 07A;&nbsp; </li><li>Reasonable Exception Statement&nbsp; received&nbsp;08-09-2025;</li><li> CIL document received&nbsp;08-09-2025.</li></ul>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
